chunks: Ahmad ibn Idris from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Qutaibah from al-Fadl ibn Shazan from Misbah from Abu Abd al-Rahman from one who heard Wahb ibn Munabbah saying:

From Ibn Abbas in a lengthy report that he said: 'O Wahb, then the Mahdi will emerge.' I said: 'Is he from your progeny?' He said: 'No, by Allah, he is not from my progeny, but from the progeny of Ali. Bliss be for the one who reaches his time. Through him, Allah will relieve the Ummah [of distress] until he fills it with equity and justice... to the end of the report.'

key_terms.الْمَهْدِيُّ: The Mahdi (the Guided One), a eschatological figure

ai.seo_question: Who is the progeny of the Mahdi according to Ibn Abbas?
ai.summary: In this narration from Ibn Abbas, the Prophet’s cousin distinguishes the Mahdi from his own lineage, affirming him as a descendant of Ali (a.s.), which underscores the Alid origin of the Twelfth Imam in Shia eschatology. The hadith highlights the Mahdi’s mission to eradicate tyranny and fill the earth with justice, a theme deeply rooted in Shia scholarly tradition regarding the restoration of divine order. This event is seen as the culmination of the prophetic mission, bringing relief to the oppressed Ummah.
